transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: This is the review of Tuesday's outage. Forty minutes of failed uploads between two and two forty p.m.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_2
transcript.text: Root cause was the storage credentials rotating without the upload service reloading them. The alert fired but paged the wrong rotation.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_3
transcript.text: Two follow-ups from my side. First, the upload service should reload credentials on rotation. Second, fix the paging rotation so it hits the on-call engineer.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: Agreed on both. Lin takes the credential reload, due next Friday. Sam fixes the paging rotation this week.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_2
transcript.text: One decision: we will not add a manual retry button in the app. The upload queue already retries; a button would hide the real problem.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: Noted, no manual retry button. Thanks everyone.
